name: manual_ead739
claim: On 64-bit Windows, Win32 APIs returning handles or pointers (like kernel32.GetCurrentProcess) require explicit restype=wintypes.HANDLE; default ctypes 32-bit truncation causes ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE in downstream security token calls.

decisions.notes: Discovered during Windows C6 private_store qualification on Windows 11 64-bit Build 26200 where OpenProcessToken failed with WinError 6.

rationale: Discovered during Windows C6 private_store qualification on Windows 11 64-bit Build 26200 where OpenProcessToken failed with WinError 6.
